Claim amendment · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-28T01:35Z

This amends claim `6458269562`, which declared "yes (widening)". The ruling left the arm to the lane, and the dev measured a narrowing. `RESERVED_RLS_MEMBERSHIP_KEYS` is also read by `MembershipKeyNameSchema` (`packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts:780`, the key-name refine on `ObjectSchema.membershipKeys`). Reserving `queues` therefore refuses an authored `membershipKeys: { queues: … }` at parse. The in-repo census on `7eb613c3` found zero such declarations.

Clause-②: no (narrowing). An authored membership key named `queues` is refused; the kernel resolves that name.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

The changeset carries a BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The new key name is the author's choice, so there is no mechanical rewrite, and the changeset gives a `**The remedy.**` line instead. The file surface is unchanged.

Landed · `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh` · 2026-10-28T05:37Z

PR #27044 merged at `e3470ed9` through the queue, under os-zhuang's Tier H approval. The merge commit is an ancestor of `origin/main`. On all 23 paths the PR touched, the merge tree matches the accepted head `e3749743` byte for byte.

`queues` is now a reserved RLS membership key. plugin-security resolves `current_user.queues` kernel-side from the ownership-queue service (`queuesOf`, the same answer the claim gate's `isMember` reads). It is resolved once per request and bound to the user and organization, and it fails closed when the service is absent or errors. An app `IRlsMembershipResolver` that answers `queues` is screened out, and an authored `membershipKeys.queues` is refused at parse. ADR-0142 D3 is amended to ruling `6457475657` (letter A).

`@objectstack/spec`, `plugin-security`, `lint` and `skills` are minor, with a BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. The card closed through `Fixes #27016`, and this seat removes `pm:dispatched`. The triage seat's delta review raised two ADR-only should-fixes (the Status-line Amended marker and the Execution plan item 1 annotation). They follow in PR #27096 (Part of #27016, skip-changeset, Tier H).
